  headerBg: "#020617",

  mainText: "#f8fafc",

  footerBg: "#020617",
  footerText: "#f8fafc",

  link: "#38bdf8",
  linkHover: "#7dd3fc"
};
export const lightTheme = {
  mode: "light",

  headerBg: "#ffffff",
  headerText: "#0f172a",

  mainBg: "#f1f5f9",
